notes.title: Patch
notes.content:
[h3]Last Patch before Launch?[/h3]
Shortly before our launch of "The Oort Cloud 2020", we have finished some minor feature improvements, bringing us closer to our finished product. 

[h3]Steam Cloud Integration[/h3]
We enabled cloud synchronization, thus your game progress is now saved into the steam cloud and sync across multiple machines. 

[h3]Visual Hit Effect[/h3]
When you were hit by enemy fire, we always displayed the shield animation. However, in some crowdy situations this could easily be overlooked. We thus added a more prominent visual effect, giving you better visual feedback. How you enjoy!

notes.title: Getting Ready for Launch Day
notes.content:
[b]German Language Support[/b]

Getting ready for the upcoming launch day, i have spent some effort to provide german localization to the game. I hope this will make it easier for german players to follow the story. 

[b]Better GamePad Support[/b]

Added some more hints about gamepad controls to follow the step-by-step tutorial approach. I recommend you play The Oort Cloud with your gamepad, however keyboard controls work perfectly fine as well.
